title: Risks with no owner or trigger
detect_signals: No trigger says when to act
sim_effect: When the risk fires nobody is watching for it, so it lands at full impact.
accepted_fixes: Give each risk an owner and a dated trigger, e.g. "no scripts by week 4"
Assign owners, triggers and contingencies at the next team meeting
partial_fixes: Assign an owner but leave the trigger open
Note the risks in the weekly summary
concept: Risk management: a risk without an owner and a trigger is just a worry
sop_ref: PM SOP: project charter risks; When Things Go Wrong
explanation: A risk nobody owns is noticed only after it has happened. An owner with a dated trigger turns it into a decision someone makes on time.
